message.text: Illustrative branch: the provider has verified the limited delegation and cleared the alarm concern. Priya must still approve these exact terms through her agent.

operation.summary: End the entire broadband service on the represented account ending 4410 at 12:00 Europe/London on 10 November 2026. Internet access ends then. No early exit fee, refund, outstanding balance, further charges or equipment return is due. No other bundled service is changed and no new contract is created. These terms do not establish whether a customer-owned alarm relies on the connection; any reported dependency must be resolved before commitment.
